newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa-Enersis deal won't up debt "substantially".
newsitem.headline: Endesa-Enersis deal won't up debt "substantially".

text.p: Spain's Endesa said on Friday that a strategic $1.5 billion alliance to take a controlling stake in Chilean utility Enersis could be achieved without a substantial increase in debt.

"The amount of the operation is a maximum of $1.5 billion, which could be financed without a substantial modification in Endesa's debt levels, and which includes $257 million in deferred payments," it said in a statement given ahead of a news conference.
Endesa said earlier that it would spend an initial 193.0 billion pesetas ($1.24 billion) to buy stakes in the Chispas group of investment firms, which control 29.04 percent of Enersis.
Enersis in turn controls Chile's largest power generator, also called Endesa.
After taking a controlling state in Enersis, Endesa said it had "taken a definitive step towards consolidating its international strategy," the statement said.
